lines.en: Wang Ming says, "Exactly. And every family makes dumplings and sets off fireworks. It's a huge celebration."

tr.am: ዋንግ ሚንግ እንዲህ አለ፦ «ልክ ነው። ደግሞ እያንዳንዱ ቤተሰብ ዱምፕሊንግ ይሠራል፣ ርችት ይተኩሳል፣ በጣም ደማቅ በዓል ነው።»

lines.text: 杰克得意地说：“那明年春节你们可别忘了，除了说‘过年好’，还得说一句‘生日快乐’。”
lines.py: Jié kè de yì de shuō: “nà míng nián chūn jié nǐ men kě bié wàng le, chú le shuō ‘guò nián hǎo’, hái děi shuō yí jù ‘shēng rì kuài lè’.”
lines.en: Jack says, very pleased with himself, "Then don't forget next Spring Festival: as well as 'Happy New Year', you'll have to say 'Happy birthday' too."
